title: Aerodroid
description: Aerodroid is designed for players who want to experience Create Aeronautics on Android with less setup hassle and better performance.
body:
# Aerodroid

Aerodroid is a lightweight Minecraft Java modpack focused on **Create: Aeronautics** with added optimization mods designed for Android devices and low-end hardware. It is made to simplify the setup process so players can enjoy Create-based automation and flying machines without spending hours configuring mods manually.

## What You Can Do
- Build automated factories and mechanical systems using Create
- Create airships and flying contraptions with Create: Aeronautics
- Explore smoother gameplay on mobile devices with performance-focused optimizations
- Play Create Aeronautics on Android launchers with reduced lag and easier setup
- Enjoy a pre-configured experience without manually installing dependencies or fixes

## Features
- Optimized for Android launchers and mobile hardware
- Includes performance and stability mods to reduce lag
- Preconfigured Create Aeronautics environment
- Simplified installation and setup process
- Compatible with multiple Android Minecraft launchers

## Supported Launchers
- ZalithLauncher 2
- Mojo Launcher
- Amethyst Launcher
- ZalithLauncher / ZalithReborn
- Pojav Glow-Worm
- Fold Craft Launcher (FCL)
